snippet.title: Back In Time - Official Announcement Trailer | Time Travel Indie game
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564520/Back_In_Time/

Back In Time is a fast-paced time travel action adventure where you travel through time to prevent disasters. Rewrite history by making critical choices, unraveling mysteries, & manipulating time itself. Explore real-world locations, and uncover secrets in a twist-filled story with evolving gameplay

History is written—but can it be rewritten?

Back In Time is a fast-paced action-adventure where you travel through history to prevent disasters. Engage in intense combat, solve time-based puzzles, and explore real-world locations filled with mysteries and hidden secrets. With a gripping story, evolving gameplay, and stunning pixel art, every decision shapes the future.

[Reuploaded due to technical error]

Website: https://omnayastudios.com/backintime/
